responses.question: Which Windows Calculator visual era/style should the app target?
responses.why: Determines the target visual language for the redesign
responses.answer: Windows 11 (Fluent Design - rounded corners, acrylic/mica, modern accent colors)

responses.question: How literal should the recreation be — layout/button grid closely matching Windows 11 Calculator, or just adopting its visual language while keeping the current layout?
responses.why: Determines fidelity of layout/spacing changes required
responses.answer: Literal recreation: layout, spacing, and button grid should closely mirror Windows 11 Calculator

responses.question: Should all existing features (financial calculator, grapher, memory, history, sound) be preserved and restyled, or should scope be trimmed to match Windows Calculator's actual feature set?
responses.why: Determines scope boundaries and whether any features are removed
responses.answer: Keep all current modes/features (scientific, unit converter, financial, grapher, memory, history, sound) with the new Windows 11 skin applied throughout

responses.question: Should the app support both light and dark themes matching Windows 11 Calculator, dark only, or keep the existing theme-switcher restyled?
responses.why: Determines theming requirements and acceptance criteria for theme switching
responses.answer: Support both light and dark themes matching Windows 11 Calculator

responses.question: Should the redesigned UI remain fully responsive/usable on mobile widths, or is desktop-first sufficient with mobile as best-effort?
responses.why: Determines responsiveness acceptance criteria since Windows Calculator is a desktop-native app
responses.answer: Must remain fully responsive/usable on mobile widths as well as desktop
